title: Context Compress Configuration
description: Configuration for Context Compress - manual and automatic context compression plugin

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocomplete

enabled.description: Enable or disable the context compression plugin

debug.description: Write a full minimized context snapshot after every successful prompt transform to ~/.config/opencode/logs/compress/context/<sessionId>/ (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/...). Not limited to compression turns; total size grows quickly with turn count — enable only while debugging

dailyLog.description: Write one-line activity log lines to ~/.config/opencode/logs/compress/daily/<YYYY-MM-DD>.log (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/...). When unset, follows debug so existing debug:true configs keep the activity log; set true with debug:false for activity only

notification.description: Level of notification shown when compression occurs

notificationType.description: Where to display compression notifications (chat message or toast notification)

protectedTurns.description: Newest OpenCode execution steps kept verbatim outside every compression

autoCompression.description: Automatically initiate model-directed compression before the context window fills

enabled.description: Enable plugin-owned automatic compression and disable native OpenCode auto-compaction

contextWindowRatio.description: Initiate compression at this fraction of the model-reported context window

tokenThreshold.description: System-wide absolute initiation threshold; the earlier of this and contextWindowRatio wins

reportNudge.description: Periodically remind the agent to bring its handoff report file up to date

enabled.description: Enable handoff report nudges for sessions that maintain a report file

tokenInterval.description: Nudge when provider-reported raw context usage crosses each multiple of this value

showCompression.description: Show summary output in the UI
